biblical_reference.note: Stephana or Stephani is a variant of the Greek name Stephanie, meaning 'crown'. In the Bible, there are several women named Stephani, including one of the seven deacons in the early Christian church (Acts 1:13) and a woman mentioned in the Book of Acts (Acts 7:58).
